expected.logged: [Backup] Warning: could not write sidecar for <file>: <error>.

notes: writeBackupMeta's own try/catch (lines 494-501) swallows the write error into a log line and returns normally. createBackup's own return value (line 303, `return status == 0`) is keyed only to the zip's exit status, never to whether the sidecar wrote successfully -- per the doc comment at 490-491: 'the backup ZIP itself is the important artifact; the sidecar is supplementary.' A backup that loses its sidecar this way is indistinguishable, once loaded, from an old pre-sidecar backup (see fixtures/backups/sidecar-missing-or-corrupt-leaves-filename-derived-defaults).
